r.경제 체제: Economy heavily reliant on remittances · aluminum, gold

t.why: It shares a long border with Afghanistan and hosts a Russian military base. It relies heavily on money sent home by workers in Russia.
t.rel: It had armed clashes with Kyrgyzstan over their border in 2021 and 2022 but signed a border treaty in 2025. It has resolved old tensions with Uzbekistan and expanded exchanges, and is considered the neighbor most critical of the Taliban government in Afghanistan to the south.
t.know: Plentiful water means hydropower produces most of its electricity.
t.etext: It sells aluminum, gold and cotton, but remittances from people working in Russia hold up much of the economy. It is building a huge dam to sell electricity.
